Updated 2026-09-14. Open to applied-AI and forward-deployed roles, consulting, and collaborations.

## Experience
- Staff Engineer, Hakimo.ai, 2023-02 to present. AI security. Real-time vision for security: the gateway and ingestion layer, edge inference, and the operator console.
  - Co-architected the gateway and ingestion layer behind 2M+ security events a day across 5,000+ cameras and 150+ customers
  - Edge inference on YOLOv11 / RF-DETR cut CPU ~60%; the in-house path avoided ~$500K of projected spend
  - WebSocket operator console: an NVR-style grid rendering hundreds of parallel camera streams at sub-second latency

## Projects
- unicorn-radar (live, https://qriousguy.com/unicorn-radar-site/): 7,852 recently funded AI companies, LLM-classified from six free data sources (Wayback Machine, SEC Form D, TechCrunch and others). 2,764 hiring for AI now, 1,132 with an Indian entity. Zero paid APIs. Snapshot 2026-08-25.
- agent-experience (live, https://qriousguy.com/agent-experience/): A field guide for designing codebases AI coding agents can actually work in. Six practices that survived adversarial fact-checking, 16 popular claims that didn't, and a case study mining 380 of my own Claude Code sessions.
- ai-events-radar (live, https://qriousguy.com/ai-events-radar/): A field guide to Bengaluru's AI and agent events scene.
- Prentice (launching soon): A workshop for the agents you train, running on your own Mac. An agent is a folder you own: a prompt, the direction you've folded in, and a manifest. Prentice schedules it, sandboxes it, records what each run did and cost, and gives you a Desk to judge its work.
- Notes & Goals (launching soon): A calm, local-first macOS app that unifies tasks, notes, and goals as plain files in a folder you choose. No cloud, no accounts.
